{{Quote|Do you see the conditions I'm living in? That insipid ''Senator'' put me in here! She deserves to ''die'' for leaving me to rot in this ''squalor''!|[[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]], on [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]|<ref name="Assassin (episode)">{{TCW|Assassin (episode)}}</ref>}}
The '''Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center''' was a high-security [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
{{Quote|We've both spent time in a ''Coruscant'' prison, so planning their jailbreak should be easy.|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], to [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]]|<ref name="Mandalorian Memories">{{TCWComicCite|6.41|Mandalorian Memories}}</ref>}}
[[File:RJCDCInterior-Assassin.png|thumb|left|220px|The holding cells and guard station within the detention center]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the prison was guarded by [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|clone shock troopers]] of the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]].<ref name="Deception">{{TCW|Deception}}</ref>

Among its prisoners was [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]]. He was freed from the prison by the [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droid]] [[HELIOS-3D/Legends|HELIOS-3D]] during a [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|hostage crisis]] involving several [[Senator/Legends|senators]] trapped inside the [[Senate East Wing/Legends|East Wing]] of the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]].<ref name="Hostage Crisis Ep Guide" /><ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

After being [[Second mission to Florrum/Legends|captured]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] were brought to the RJC Detention Center for their part in the [[Sabotage of the Endurance/Legends|destruction]] of the Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']], along with their attempted assassination of [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and murder of numerous [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].<ref name="Lethal Trackdown">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:RepublicPrison-CompleteS1.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art of the Republic prison]]
The prison's design bears strong resemblance to [[Wikipedia:Panopticon|Panopticon]], a conception of a round prison with cells being exposed towards the center, thus providing the guards a possibility of discretely observing every inmate at the same time from that central point - a tower. Although, as the RJCDC prisoners were perfectly aware they have been watched - the clone troopers held guard at the platform of the central tower - the idea of Panopticon was not wholly fulfilled in that prison.
